VPC, Subnets and Security Groups

A virtual private network contains subnets and routing; security groups control allowed network
traffic for resources.

# Illustrative inbound rules
Load balancer: TCP 443 from Internet
API: TCP 3000 from LB security group
DB: TCP 5432 from API security group

configured.
Why avoid exposing the database to the Internet?
Reduce exposure and allow only authorized application connections.
